verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Snowflake's COPY INTO/Snowpipe ingestion path from cloud stages (referenced via stream and Snowpipe docs, plus a community mention of COPY skipping already-loaded files and JSON Lines usage) and separate support for semi-structured JSON data types, but the pack never explicitly documents a single COPY INTO command example covering CSV, JSON, and Parquet together. missing for 10: explicit doc snippet naming CSV/Parquet file format support in COPY INTO, and a concrete single-command example spanning all three formats.
